messages:
Mira (PM): Quick sync: we need a lightweight "network-impact" summary for private upgrades so field and netops can fast-accept or reject. Idea: one-line stamp + optional detailed preflight artifact.

Jon (eng): Suggested stamp values: OK, ALERT, BLOCK. CLI: `installer --preflight --stamp` prints stamp and writes preflight.json to assets. Keep default behaviour: no-host-change unless preset chosen.

Sophie (field): Field wants printable preflight and an "approval token" customers can paste in help tickets. Airgap: signed-bundle sha needed.

Ravi (netops): Require deterministic egress note and explicit list of firewall ports for ALERT/BLOCK. Bridge/peer changes require netops sign-off. Default preserve-egress=false.

ci-bot: ci-bot: queued preflight-run for pilot-org-9 at 01:00 UTC

Mira (PM): Actions: Jon -> implement stamp + asset write (ETA 4d). Ravi -> firewall quick-list (ETA 3d). Sophie -> pilot nominations (ETA 2d). We'll gate GA on 3 pilot PASSes and signed-bundle support. Keep stamp terse so field can scan quickly.
